findings.evidence: import.ts:137 prints formatRunCounts(RunResult); import-snapshot.ts drain does not copy ImportParseResult.errors into SyncBatch. Executed unsupported-part: health.detail records=1; 1 record errors (unsupported_part=1) while formatRunCounts errors=0.
findings.invariant: Public import/backfill progress counts ledger/run failures, not ChatGPT record errors.
findings.required_for: P070/P087 must not assume import stdout lists unsupported_part. Doctor/connect health is the import-report surface.

findings.evidence: connections.ts:365-368 blocksEnrollment only for states other than ok|degraded. import.ts:98-102.
findings.invariant: A degraded ChatGPT export enrolls and can store events with CLI exit 0.

findings.evidence: packages/cli/test has no chatgpt import case. Closest: e2e.test.ts:20-31 markdown-folder; x-archive-import.test.ts:12-47. import-report.ts has no unit test.
findings.action: P070 should add CLI assertions from expected-counts-status.json, not a second parser suite.

findings.evidence: connectors/README.md:50-57 says snapshot importers never emit tombstones; import-chatgpt/index.ts:94-100 sets tombstones:true and import-snapshot.ts:177-183 emits them. P006 owns canonical docs.
findings.action: Do not rewrite docs in this packet.

findings.evidence: Executed summarizeImportErrors on 33 empty_content rows: '33 record errors (empty_content=33; truncated=1)'. Codes are not truncated; only a remainder count is appended. Doctor then caps at 160 chars.

blockers: CLI process-seam execution requires a bun@1.3.14 workspace install (node_modules). Not present in this read-only archive; install is out of scope.
next_step: P070: add a CLI ChatGPT progress/health harness using /work/out/fixtures and expected-counts-status.json on a workspace-installed checkout. Do not duplicate chatgpt.test.ts mapper cases. P087: consume the source-to-summary map. P006 if README tombstone sentence is in scope.

downstream_handoff.P070: CLI public-summary tests and any progress-line change. Fixtures and expected stdout/exit codes are in expected-counts-status.json. Treat parse-error omission from formatRunCounts as current behavior unless that packet is assigned to surface it.
